#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise dispatch records through the real Spacedock binary in split-root repos."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import uuid

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WRAPPER = ROOT / "scripts/dispatch_stage.py"
CHECKER = ROOT / "scripts/dispatch_records.py"
BINARY = os.environ.get("SPACEDOCK_BIN")


class DispatchStageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dispatch-stage-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(temporary.name).resolve()
        self.repo = self.base / "code"
        self.workflow = self.repo / "docs/dev2"
        self.workflow.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.slug = "dispatch-fixture-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.addCleanup(self.remove_artifacts)
        self.env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                    if key not in ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_COMMON_DIR")}
        self.env.update(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="Dispatch Fixture", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Dispatch Fixture",
                        GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fixture@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="fixture@example.invalid",
                        GIT_CONFIG_COUNT="2", GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0="commit.gpgsign", GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="false",
                        GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1="core.hooksPath", GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="/dev/null", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        (self.workflow / "README.md").write_bytes((ROOT / "references/sd/workflow.md").read_bytes())
        (self.repo / ".gitignore").write_text(".worktrees/\n**/.spacedock-state/\n")
        self.call(["git", "init", "--initial-branch=main", self.repo])
        self.git(self.repo, "add", "--", ".gitignore", "docs/dev2/README.md")
        self.git(self.repo, "commit", "-m", "test: workflow")
        self.state = self.workflow / ".spacedock-state"
        self.git(self.repo, "worktree", "add", "--detach", self.state)
        self.git(self.state, "checkout", "--orphan", "spacedock-state/dev2")
        self.git(self.state, "rm", "-rf", ".")
        self.entity = self.state / f"{self.slug}.md"
        self.entity.write_text("---\ntitle: Synthetic dispatch\nvariant: kc-dev-flow-2\nprofile: pilot\n"
                               "status: ideation\n---\n\n## FO alignment\n\nSurfaces: none\nVisible change: none\n")
        self.commit_task()
        self.folder = self.state / self.slug
        self.checklist = self.base / "checklist.txt"
        self.checklist.write_text("Inspect the real dispatch seam\nKeep the received second checklist line\n")
        self.notes = self.base / "notes.txt"
        self.notes.write_text(f"Package root: {ROOT}\nSend your completion message to `main`.\n"
                              "Keep this second scope-notes line verbatim.\n")
        self.spy = self.base / "spy"
        self.marker = self.base / "called"
        self.spy.write_text(f"#!{sys.executable}\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport subprocess, sys\n"
                            f"Path({str(self.marker)!r}).write_text('called')\n"
                            f"sys.exit(subprocess.call([{BINARY!r}, *sys.argv[1:]]))\n")
        self.spy.chmod(0o755)

    def remove_artifacts(self):
        for path in Path("/tmp/spacedock-dispatch").glob(f"*{self.slug}*"):
            if path.is_file():
                path.unlink()

    def call(self, args, expected=0, child_env=None, data=None):
        result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, args)), cwd=self.base, env=child_env or self.env,
                                input=data, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        if os.environ.get("DISPATCH_STAGE_LOG"):
            with Path(os.environ["DISPATCH_STAGE_LOG"]).open("a") as log:
                log.write(json.dumps(dict(argv=list(map(str, args)), exit=result.returncode,
                                          stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)) + "\n")
        if expected is not None:
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, expected, (args, result.stdout, result.stderr))
        return result

    def git(self, root, *args):
        return self.call(["git", "--literal-pathspecs", "-C", root, *args]).stdout.strip()

    def commit_task(self):
        self.git(self.state, "add", "--", self.entity.relative_to(self.state))
        self.git(self.state, "commit", "-m", "test: task")

    def set_stage(self, stage):
        self.entity.write_text(self.entity.read_text().replace("status: ideation", f"status: {stage}"))
        self.commit_task()

    def build(self, stage="ideation", extra=(), expected=0, cleanup_spy=False, child_env=None):
        launch = [sys.executable, "-B", WRAPPER]
        if cleanup_spy:
            script = ("import sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv.pop(1)); "
                      "import dispatch_stage as subject; original = subject.remove_uncommitted; "
                      "marker = Path(sys.argv.pop(1)); "
                      "subject.remove_uncommitted = lambda *a: (marker.write_text('called'), original(*a))[1]; "
                      "sys.exit(subject.main())")
            launch = [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", script, WRAPPER.parent, self.base / "cleanup-called"]
        return self.call([*launch, "--workflow-dir", self.workflow,
                          "--entity-path", self.entity, "--stage", stage, "--model", "fixture-model",
                          "--checklist-file", self.checklist, "--scope-notes-file", self.notes,
                          "--spacedock", BINARY, "--host", "codex", *extra], expected, child_env)

    def record(self, stage="ideation", number=1):
        return self.folder / "dispatch" / f"{stage}-{number}.md"

    def assert_committed(self, path, subject):
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "log", "-1", "--format=%s", "--", path), subject)
        root = Path(self.git(self.state, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"))
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "show", f"HEAD:{path.relative_to(root)}"), path.read_text().strip())
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "status", "--porcelain", "--", path), "")

    def test_stamp_commits_complete_record_and_exact_inputs(self):
        dispatched = self.git(self.workflow, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        result = self.build(extra=("--roster", "fixture roster", "--note", "README fixture"))
        envelope = json.loads(result.stdout)
        record = self.record()
        self.assert_committed(record, f"dispatch: {self.slug} entering ideation")
        self.call([sys.executable, "-B", CHECKER, self.folder])
        self.call([sys.executable, "-B", CHECKER, "--names", "--strict", record])
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Refuse candidates that change an applied migration or take a number another task holds, and reserve numbers per task.

check   exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 misconfiguration. Rules: R1 a migration present at the merge-base is
        modified or deleted; R2 the same against every 'Applied at: <env> <sha>' commit; R3 an added migration
        number is not above the base tip's highest; R4 an added migration or ADR number is not in the task's
        'Migration:' / 'ADR:' lines; R5 an added ADR number exists on the base tip; R6 a task whose frontmatter says
        'profile: poc' differs from the merge-base anywhere under the migrations directory; R7 (only under
        'migrations-path: none') the candidate adds a file named NNNN_name.sql anywhere; R8 an added ADR
        number absent from the base tip is held by another live task.
        'migrations-path: none' declares that the repository has no migration files: R1 to R3 and R6 are skipped,
        the ADR rules R4, R5 and R8 still run, and a db task is no longer exit 2.
reserve prints 'Migration: NNNN' or 'ADR: NNNN' (one above the base tip and every other live task, never
        filling a gap); a task that already holds a line gets it back. One number per kind per task.
Holders: own state *.md and */index.md, plus every origin/spacedock-state/* branch fetched explicitly.
        The checked task's path is excluded on its own branch only when its state checkout has origin.
Limits: only files named NNNN_name.sql count as migrations, so meta/_journal.json and snapshots are not checked (R6 does check them);
a deploy nobody recorded as 'Applied at:' is not detected; run 'git -C <repo> fetch' first, the base tip is what is local.
Task lines are read from the task's '## Number guards' section.
"""
import argparse
import posixpath
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

MIGRATION = re.compile(r"^(\d+)_.+\.sql$")
ADR = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})-.+\.md$")
NO_MIGRATIONS = "none"
KINDS = {"migration": ("Migration", MIGRATION), "adr": ("ADR", ADR)}


class Misconfigured(Exception):
    pass


def git(repo, *args):
    done = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if done.returncode:
        raise Misconfigured(f"git {' '.join(args)}: {done.stderr.strip()}")
    return done.stdout


def resolve(repo, ref, what="ref"):
    done = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", f"{ref}^{{commit}}"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    if done.returncode:
        raise Misconfigured(f"cannot resolve {what} '{ref}' in {repo}")
    return done.stdout.strip()


def frontmatter(readme):
    if not readme.is_file():
        raise Misconfigured(f"no workflow README at {readme}")
    return frontmatter_text(readme.read_text())


def frontmatter_text(text):
    lines = text.split("\n")
    found = {}
    for line in lines[1:] if lines[0] == "---" else []:
        if line == "---":
            break
        match = re.match(r"^([\w-]+):[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*$", line)
        if match:
            found[match.group(1)] = match.group(2).strip("'\"")
    return found


def task_facts(path):
    task = Path(path)
    if not task.is_file():
        raise Misconfigured(f"task file {task} does not exist")
    return task_facts_text(task.read_text(errors="replace"))


def task_facts_text(text):
    section = re.search(r"^## Number guards[ \t]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
    body = section.group(1) if section else ""
    surfaces = re.search(r"^Surfaces:(.*)$", text, re.M)
    return {
        "migration": {int(n) for n in re.findall(r"^Migration:[ \t]*(\d+)[ \t]*$", body, re.M)},
        "adr": {int(n) for n in re.findall(r"^ADR:[ \t]*(\d+)[ \t]*$", body, re.M)},
        "applied": re.findall(r"^Applied at:[ \t]*(\S+)[ \t]+([0-9a-f]{7,40})[ \t]*$", body, re.M),
        "poc": frontmatter_text(text).get("profile") == "poc",
        "surfaces": set(re.split(r"[\s,]+", surfaces.group(1).strip())) if surfaces else set(),
    }


def numbered(repo, ref, directory, pattern):
    found = {}
    for path in git(repo, "ls-tree", "--name-only", ref, directory.rstrip("/") + "/").splitlines():
        match = pattern.match(posixpath.basename(path))
        if match:
            found.setdefault(int(match.group(1)), []).append(posixpath.basename(path))
    return found


def added_changed(repo, old, new, directory, pattern):
    """Return (added files, files present at old and modified or deleted at new) among numbered files in directory."""
    added, touched = [], []
    out = git(repo, "diff", "--name-status", "--no-renames", old, new, "--", directory.rstrip("/") + "/")
    for line in out.splitlines():
        status, path = line.split("\t", 1)
        if posixpath.dirname(path) != directory.rstrip("/") or not pattern.match(posixpath.basename(path)):
            continue
        (added if status == "A" else touched).append((status, path))
    return added, touched

    cfg = frontmatter(Path(args.workflow_dir) / "README.md") if args.workflow_dir else {}
    base = args.base
    if not base and cfg.get("trunk"):
        remote = f"origin/{cfg['trunk']}"
        base = remote if subprocess.run(["git", "-C", args.repo, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", remote],
                                        capture_output=True).returncode == 0 else cfg["trunk"]
    if not base:
        raise Misconfigured("no base: pass --base, or --workflow-dir whose README declares trunk:")
    return {
        "migrations": args.migrations_path or cfg.get("migrations-path"),
        "adr": args.adr_path or cfg.get("adr-path") or "docs/adr",
        "base": base,
        "state": getattr(args, "state_dir", None) or (cfg.get("state") and str(Path(args.workflow_dir) / cfg["state"])),
        "state_branch": cfg.get("state-branch") or (
            f"spacedock-state/{Path(args.workflow_dir).resolve().name}" if args.workflow_dir else None),
    }
